extracted.intended_audience: prospective patent bar exam candidates / individuals preparing for the USPTO registration exam
extracted.subtask_description: Description and promotion of PLI's Patent Bar Review course aimed at helping candidates pass the USPTO registration (patent bar) exam via exam-focused materials, lectures, and practice software. Emphasizes live and home-study delivery with simulated practice questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exam-focused course design
rubrics_metrics.description: Every element of the course is Exam-focused — from the structure, to the materials, to the lectures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course is organized specifically around the content and format of the PTO Exam rather than a broad survey of patent law; design decisions prioritize what is needed to pass.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concentration only on necessary material
rubrics_metrics.description: The Course concentrates only on what you need to know to pass the Exam. You don’t need a distracting survey of patent law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoids extraneous doctrinal or historical material; teaches targeted, test-relevant rules, doctrines, and practice points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted resources that zero in on exam issues
rubrics_metrics.description: A combination of targeted resources that zero in quickly and confidently on the issues, problems, questions and strategies that will enable you to ace this major test.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials and pedagogy emphasize common exam issues, problem types, question strategies, and practical approaches to maximize exam performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Same content quality across delivery formats
rubrics_metrics.description: You’ll find that same focus, and that quality and integrity, whether you take a live or home-study version of PLI’s Patent Bar Review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Live courses and home-study options are intended to provide equivalent substantive content and instructional quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full set of written materials included
rubrics_metrics.description: A full set of the written materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive printed or digital coursebook(s) supplied as part of the course to support learning and review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to all lectures online
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students receive online access to lecture recordings or streamed sessions for review and flexible study scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive practice software (PatWare) simulating the exam
rubrics_metrics.description: Our interactive software, PatWare, which will take you through thousands of questions in a format that simulates the actual Exam.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides large-volume question practice in an exam-like interface and conditions; intended to build familiarity with question styles, timing, and exam simulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration and promotional details
rubrics_metrics.description: To register for a live or home study course, call toll-free (888) 296-5973 or CLICK HERE. Mention IPWatchdog.com & Save 10%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical enrollment instructions and a reader discount; not a pedagogical criterion but relevant for prospective attendees evaluating course access and cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on quality and integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: You’ll find that same focus, and that quality and integrity, whether you take a live or home-study version of PLI’s Patent Bar Review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit promise that materials and instruction adhere to professional standards and trustworthy presentation of exam-relevant content.
